name: Shouyou
excerpt: Shouyou is Bokuto's son who has a budding friendship with Kageyama.
notes: Shouyou is Bokuto's son who is involved in a playful yet competitive friendship with Kageyama. He is described as having red hair and big golden eyes. Shouyou is enthusiastic about volleyball and looks up to his father. He has a tendency to be a bit masochistic, as he keeps touching a bruise on his knee. Shouyou is eager to be liked by Kageyama and is thrilled when they play volleyball together.
